mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP over the last quarter indicates strong economic demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 increased in the last quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points within the last month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage costs and reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3pp in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% within the last month signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and retail sales signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increased by more than 1% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index by more than 0.5% within the last month signals easing inflationary pressures, which reduces input costs and boosts corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL decreased by more than 0.5% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 within the last month signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real GDP and a decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points within the last quarter signals strong economic growth and labor market tightening, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increase and UNRATE decrease > 0.3pp in 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 increased and UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3pp in the last quarter.
